page_title: DAR 1-3 RBL | Darmstadt v RB Leipzig 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

90+5' Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Darmstadt.
90+5' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+4' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Now RB Leipzig have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marcel Schuhen.
86' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
85' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

85' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Darmstadt will take a corner.
83' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
82' It seems like Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
82' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
80' Here is a change. Xavi Simons is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig).
80' Here comes a substitution. Lois Openda is given a rest as he is replaced by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig).
79' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
79' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
79' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out for offside!

72' 1 - 3 A superb goal from great team play! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
72' Attention! Referee Harm Osmers straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
72' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
71' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
68' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
68' Yellow card. Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The ball is cleared after Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
66' Darmstadt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
64' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Oscar Vilhelmsson will be replaced by Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt).
64' A substitution has been made. Luca Pfeiffer is replaced by Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt).
64' It is time for a substitution. Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is on for Christoph Klarer.
63' David Raum (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card for infringement.
62' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Benjamin Henrichs and he is replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
62' Substitution. Amadou Haidara walks off the pitch and Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Emil Forsberg will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
60' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) for his blatant foul.
58' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Fabian Holland is replaced by Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt).
57' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
56' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) picks up an injury.
53' Darmstadt show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
51' Darmstadt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
47' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Darmstadt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45+2' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45+1' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) will take the free kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.

43' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
42' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
37' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
34' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
32' 1 - 2 Goal! Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Janis Blaswich to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
32' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
31' Harm Osmers couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) and blew his whistle. The referee gives a penalty kick to Darmstadt!!

29' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Darmstadt are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
28' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
28' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is about to take a corner kick.
27' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt).
26' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
24' 0 - 2 Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) fires a daisy-cutter inside the right post from the free kick just outside the box. Football supporters are always happy to see such a fabulous goal.
23' Harm Osmers blows his whistle. Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) commits a foul after dangerous play.
22' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) heads on.
20' Janis Blaswich displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
19' RB Leipzig showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

17' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
14' Janis Blaswich (RB Leipzig) sends a long through ball to Emil Forsberg, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
13' That's unlucky! Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
13' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
12' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) picks up a long through ball, but Marcel Schuhen deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
10' Wonderful movement by Darmstadt. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

9' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom left corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Marcel Schuhen made a comfortable save.
7' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
5' David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will take a throw-in.
1' 0 - 1 Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Harm Osmers is the one to supervise the game today.
